stories.title: India has an ambitious plan to lure scientists back — will it work?
stories.summary: Nature, Published online: 01 September 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02636-9 Initiatives to attract Indian researchers who are working abroad do not offer long-term income security, some scientists say
stories.extract:
India is the latest country that is trying to entice researchers who have moved abroad to come back and help to reverse the country’s brain drain. Scientists mostly support these initiatives, which offer generous fellowships and research funding. But some say the programmes are unlikely to make much of a difference, because they don’t address the reasons that many researchers leave the country in the first place, such as a lack of research infrastructure and income security.

stories.extract:
The fastest century in first-class cricket by time spent at the crease was scored more than a century ago, yet the record remains intact. Percy Fender smashed his hundred in just 35 minutes for Surrey against Northamptonshire at Northampton on August 26, 1920 — and despite several later centuries being completed in less time, none have been accepted as a genuine challenge to his mark.

stories.title: Men’s cricket: India, Sri Lanka second test match ended draw; India clinch series 1-0
stories.extract:
In Men’s Cricket, the second and final Test between India and Sri Lanka ended in a draw, with the hosts at 429 for 9 in their second innings on the fifth and final day in Colombo.
Despite the draw, the Shubman Gill-led side clinched the two-match series 1-0.
